description: Source code for SynthEngine class implementing a simple polyphonic MIDI synthesizer with audio processing, MIDI event handling, and voice management.

classes.name: SynthEngine
classes.description: Main class for a simple polyphonic MIDI synthesizer, handling MIDI events, voice management, and audio output.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending MidiReceiver to handle incoming MIDI messages and trigger corresponding actions.

classes.name: MyRunnable
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to run the audio synthesis loop in a background thread.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data and forwards it to the event scheduler if active.

methods.name: onLoopStarted
methods.description: Hook called before the synthesis loop starts.

methods.name: onBufferCompleted
methods.description: Hook called after each buffer is processed.

methods.name: onLoopEnded
methods.description: Hook called when the synthesis loop ends.

methods.name: processMidiEvents
methods.description: Processes scheduled MIDI events and sends them through the framer.

methods.name: generateBuffer
methods.description: Generates audio buffer by mixing active voices.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles note-off MIDI events, stopping the corresponding voice.

methods.name: createVoice
methods.description: Creates a new SynthVoice based on the program number.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles note-on MIDI events, starting or reusing voices.

methods.name: pitchBend
methods.description: Adjusts pitch bend and updates voice frequency scalers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the synthesizer and background thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the synthesizer and background thread.
